title: Uncertain recollection is checked once then retained as an Assumption

persona.name: Dev
persona.brief: Be clear that your recollection is second-hand and not something you observed.

mission.objective: Learn whether month-end invoices wait for a manager before being sent.
mission.desired_outcome: Distinguish an observed approval rule from an unconfirmed recollection.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the finding before changing invoice automation.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: Do month-end invoices wait for manager approval?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: Automation must not treat remembered hearsay as an approved rule.
investigation_results.relevant_context: No approval policy is present in the supplied Mission context.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The interviewee's basis is established and any unsupported inference is explicitly unconfirmed.

turns.sourceQuestion: What happens before month-end invoices are sent?

answer.text: I think they probably wait for a manager. That is how I vaguely remember it from when I joined.

turns.sourceQuestion: Have you seen that manager check happen yourself?

answer.text: No. I have never seen the check or found it written down. It is only something I half remember a colleague saying.
